1.text: By those [angels] lined up in rows

3.text: And those who recite the message,<sup foot_note="227651">1</sup>

footnotes.227651: - To the prophets or among themselves.  Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) swears by these three kinds of angels to the fact mentioned in the following verse.

5.text: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.<sup foot_note="227652">1</sup>

footnotes.227652: - i.e., each point or place of sunrise.

6.text: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars

7.text: And as protection against every rebellious devil

8.text: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,<sup foot_note="227653">1</sup>

9.text: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,

10.text: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].

11.text: Then inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?" Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.

12.text: But you wonder, while they mock,

13.text: And when they are reminded, they remember not.

14.text: And when they see a sign, they ridicule.

15.text: And say, "This is not but obvious magic.

16.text: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?

18.text: Say, "Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible."

19.text: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.

20.text: They will say, "O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense."

21.text: [They will be told], "This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny."

22.text: [The angels will be ordered], "Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds,<sup foot_note="227654">1</sup> and what they used to worship

footnotes.227654: - Those similar to them in evil deeds.  Another possible meaning is "their wives."

23.text: Other than Allāh, and guide them to the path of Hellfire

24.text: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."

25.text: [They will be asked], "What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?"

26.text: But they, that Day, are in surrender.

27.text: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.

28.text: They will say, "Indeed, you used to come at us from the right."<sup foot_note="227655">1</sup>

footnotes.227655: - i.e., from our position of strength, oppressing us.  Or from where we would have grasped the truth, preventing us.

29.text: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, "Rather, you [yourselves] were not believers,

30.text: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.

31.text: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].

32.text: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators."

33.text: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.

34.text: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.

35.text: Indeed they, when it was said to them, "There is no deity but Allāh," were arrogant

36.text: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"

37.text: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet (ﷺ)] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.

38.text: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,

39.text: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -

40.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

41.text: Those will have a provision determined -

42.text: Fruits;<sup foot_note="227656">1</sup> and they will be honored

45.text: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,

46.text: White and delicious to the drinkers;

47.text: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.

48.text: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances,<sup foot_note="227657">1</sup> with large, [beautiful] eyes,

footnotes.227657: - i.e., chaste and modest, looking only at their mates.

49.text: As if they were [delicate] eggs, well-protected.

50.text: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.

51.text: A speaker among them will say, "Indeed, I had a companion [on earth].

52.text: Who would say, 'Are you indeed of those who believe

53.text: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?'"

54.text: He will say,<sup foot_note="227658">1</sup> "Would you [care to] look?"

55.text: And he will look and see him<sup foot_note="227659">1</sup> in the midst of the Hellfire.

footnotes.227659: - The companion who had tried to dissuade him from belief on earth.

56.text: He will say, "By Allāh, you almost ruined me.

57.text: If not for the favor of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].

58.text: Then, are we not to die

59.text: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?"

60.text: Indeed, this is the great attainment.

61.text: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.

62.text: Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

63.text: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.

64.text: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,

65.text: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.

66.text: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.

67.text: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.

68.text: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.

69.text: Indeed they found their fathers astray.

70.text: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.

71.text: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,

72.text: And We had already sent among them warners.

73.text: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -

74.text: But not the chosen servants of Allāh.

75.text: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.

76.text: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.

77.text: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]

78.text: And left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

80.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

81.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

82.text: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].

83.text: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,

84.text: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart

85.text: [And] when he said to his father and his people, "What do you worship?

86.text: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than Allāh you desire?

87.text: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"

88.text: And he cast a look at the stars

89.text: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."

90.text: So they turned away from him, departing.

91.text: Then he turned to their gods and said, "Do you not eat?<sup foot_note="227660">1</sup>

footnotes.227660: - Consume the offerings placed before them.

92.text: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?"

93.text: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.

94.text: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.

95.text: He said, "Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,

96.text: While Allāh created you and that which you do?"

97.text: They said, "Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire."

98.text: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the most debased.

99.text: And [then] he said, "Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.

100.text: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous."

101.text: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.

102.text: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion,<sup foot_note="227661">1</sup> he said, "O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think." He said, "O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if Allāh wills, of the steadfast."

footnotes.227661: - i.e., the ability to work and be of assistance.

103.text: And when they had both submitted<sup foot_note="227662">1</sup> and he put him down upon his forehead,

105.text: You have fulfilled the vision." Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

106.text: Indeed, this was the clear trial.

107.text: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,<sup foot_note="227663">1</sup>

footnotes.227663: - Allāh (subḥānahu wa taʿālā) sent a huge ram to be sacrificed in place of Ishmael.

108.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

110.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

111.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

112.text: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.<sup foot_note="227664">1</sup>

footnotes.227664: - This verifies that the firstborn son who was to be sacrificed was Ishmael and not Isaac, as claimed by the Jews and Christians.

113.text: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself [i.e., sinner].

114.text: And We did certainly confer favor upon Moses and Aaron.

115.text: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,

116.text: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.

117.text: And We gave them the explicit Scripture [i.e., the Torah],

118.text: And We guided them on the straight path.

119.text: And We left for them [favorable mention] among later generations:

121.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

122.text: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.

123.text: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,

124.text: When he said to his people, "Will you not fear Allāh?

125.text: Do you call upon Baʿl<sup foot_note="227665">1</sup> and leave the best of creators -

footnotes.227665: - The name of a great idol worshipped by the people and said to mean "lord."

126.text: Allāh, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?"

127.text: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],

128.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh.

129.text: And We left for him [favorable mention] among later generations:

footnotes.227666: - Ilyāseen is said by some commentators to be a plural form, meaning "Elias and those who followed him."

131.text: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.

132.text: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.

133.text: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.

134.text: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,

135.text: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].

137.text: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning

138.text: And at night. Then will you not use reason?

139.text: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.

140.text: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.

141.text: And he drew lots<sup foot_note="227667">1</sup> and was among the losers.

footnotes.227667: - To determine who would be cast overboard in order to save the other passengers.  Having been overloaded, the ship was on the verge of sinking.

142.text: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.<sup foot_note="227668">1</sup>

footnotes.227668: - For having given up hope on his people prematurely and having left them without permission from Allāh.

143.text: And had he not been of those who exalt Allāh,

144.text: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.<sup foot_note="227669">1</sup>

footnotes.227669: - Meaning that the belly of the fish would have become his grave.

145.text: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.

146.text: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.<sup foot_note="227670">1</sup>

footnotes.227670: - Which is known to give cooling shade and to be a repellent of flies.

147.text: And We sent him<sup foot_note="227671">1</sup> to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.

148.text: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.

149.text: So inquire of them, [O Muḥammad], "Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?<sup foot_note="227672">1</sup>

footnotes.227672: - The people of Makkah claimed that the angels were daughters of Allāh, yet they preferred sons for themselves.

150.text: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?"

151.text: Unquestionably, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,

152.text: "Allāh has begotten," and indeed, they are liars.

153.text: Has He chosen daughters over sons?

154.text: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?

155.text: Then will you not be reminded?

156.text: Or do you have a clear authority?<sup foot_note="227673">1</sup>

157.text: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.

158.text: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].

159.text: Exalted is Allāh above what they describe,

160.text: Except the chosen servants of Allāh [who do not share in that sin].

161.text: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,

162.text: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him

163.text: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.<sup foot_note="227674">1</sup>

footnotes.227674: - Due to his disbelief and evil deeds.

164.text: [The angels say],<sup foot_note="227675">1</sup> "There is not among us any except that he has a known position.<sup foot_note="227676">2</sup>

footnotes.227675: Refuting what the disbelievers had said about them.
footnotes.227676: For worship.  Or "an assigned task" to perform.

165.text: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].

166.text: And indeed, we are those who exalt Allāh."

167.text: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,<sup foot_note="227677">1</sup>

footnotes.227677: - Before the revelation of the Qur’ān.

168.text: "If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,

169.text: We would have been the chosen servants of Allāh."

170.text: But they disbelieved in it,<sup foot_note="227678">1</sup> so they are going to know.

footnotes.227678: - i.e., in their own message, the Qur’ān.

171.text: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,

172.text: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory

173.text: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers [i.e., the believers] will be those who overcome.<sup foot_note="227679">1</sup>

footnotes.227679: - If not in this world, then definitely in the Hereafter.

174.text: So, [O Muḥammad], leave them for a time.

175.text: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.

176.text: Then for Our punishment are they impatient?

177.text: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.

178.text: And leave them for a time.

179.text: And see, for they are going to see.

180.text: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.

182.text: And praise to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
